class.name: OpenXRVendorDeviceInfo
class.brief_description: Provides the model and vendor-specific operating system identity of the active XR device.
class.description: The Android library is built with one vendor flavor per export. This singleton therefore provides one common API while the active vendor supplies the device-specific values. [method get_device_info] returns a dictionary with the keys [code]model[/code], [code]os[/code], and [code]os_version[/code]. Values are empty when the information is unavailable or when the project is not running on Android.

method.name: get_device_info
method.description: Returns the device model and vendor OS identity. The OS version is intended for comparison with the vendor's documented compatibility mapping; it must be treated as an opaque vendor-defined string.
